errands.ask: Make the Capital Today tab show the next ex-dividend date next to each holding.

order.title: Show next ex-dividend date in Capital Today tab
order.why: Helps spot upcoming dividend cutoffs without opening each ticker detail.
acceptance: Each holding row in Capital Today displays its next ex-dividend date when known
Missing dates render an em dash without shifting column alignment
Existing Capital browser test passes with zero console errors
order.notes_for_solver: Reuse the existing date formatter in capital-core.js and render via textContent.
